CustomField.description: True when this external value means "no value": inbound leaves the Work_Item__c field blank, and a blank field pushes out as this value. Normalized Value must then be empty; a row with both is contradictory and maps nothing. Explicit because an empty Normalized Value on its own marks a half-filled row, which also maps nothing - the checkbox is what tells the two apart. Build 09: Jira's en dash priority (id 10000), which exists because a Jira issue cannot be without a priority. Asana needs no such row: an empty enum field is Asana's own "none", and its adapter knows that.
CustomField.label: Maps To Blank
